hints: Add two single bits by hand. What is the result bit, and what is carried?
The result bit is the exclusive-or of the two; the carry is their `and`, and it belongs one place to the left.
So `first ^ second` is the sum ignoring every carry, and `(first & second) << 1` is every carry. Add those two together - which is the same problem again.
Repeat until there is nothing left to carry. It terminates because each round pushes the carries one place further left, and there are only so many places.
